Heaven Tree will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its project management software Clovine.

Since 2017, Heaven Tree has been developingand supplying business management software to various industries includingmanufacturing, telecommunications, and fashion. It aims to respond to andsupply customers' advanced business software solutions with fast and accuratesoftware product development to meet the growing demand.

△ Customized solution with freely set process according to CMMI, PMBOK® △ Enterprise program optimized for sharing and collaboration through cloud automatic synchronization technology △ Fast deployment period of 15-30 days and easy and convenient use for anyone △ Applying the advantages of cloud securing speed and convenience △ Breakthrough technology solution that becomes faster with more users △ No need to build expensive physical server required when building ERP and PDM and saving cost due to it

An official said, “We decided to develop Clovine because we believe that companies and individuals need to minimize the loss and workload due to the errors in the project management and increase the efficiency of their work.”

He continued, “The major markets are Vietnam, Singapore, Hong Kong, the Middle East, and the United States, and we are working with a global IT research and consulting company G to specifically analyze the trend of technical development and make corporate growth plan. Thanks to Company G's support, we and G will expand sales to the US by our participation in CES 2020, as well as providing sales and marketing to end users worldwide.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
